text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - post-deploy regression: small config change caused routing errors in eu-gpu pool (pages: oncall)

elaine: ack, oncall here. seeing 502 spikes from /v1/generate in eu region, started ~5m after the canary roll

sam: copying logs -> `ingress: upstream 502, connection reset by peer` and `runtime: failed to allocate kv-cache` from a couple of replicas

elaine: my quick check: the rollout added `INFERENCE_CACHE_SIZE=0` to one replica set by mistake. that will break prefix caching and cause OOM-ish behavior under warm traffic :grimacing:

mohit: who shipped the micropatch? ping @sam

sam: it was #deploy 2026-03-15 02:14, commit `b7f9c3a` — small env change merged from feature/config-tune

james-support: Customer reports: AcmeCorp seeing request failures for payments flow in eu-west-1, severity high. They called support channel.

elaine: kill-switch: enabling feature flag `prefetch-cache` -> OFF for eu cluster to stop the broken path. doing a flag toggle now.

deploy-bot: API: feature flag update - key=prefetch-cache, scope=eu, state=off, initiated_by=elaine

elaine: toggled. immediately starting rolling-restart of affected replicas to clear bad envs. command:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart rs/inference-eu-v2
``` 

sam: also preparing a fast revert of the config commit. `git revert --no-commit b7f9c3a && git commit -m "revert: remove accidental INFERENCE_CACHE_SIZE=0"`

mohit: can we do a single-commit revert and push as a micropatch, then kick a canary to verify? we should avoid full rollback unless necessary.

elaine: agreed. I'll coordinate the revert + micropatch. sam, can you cut the patch? I'll monitor metrics and handle customer comms.

sam: patch branch ready -> `hotfix/revert-config-b7f9c3a`, pushing now. CI green. deploying to canary subset (5%) in eu.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started - service=inference-eu, subset=canary-5pct, image=hotfix-revert-20260315

elaine: metrics: error-rate eu decreased from 7.8% -> 1.1% in the canary within 90s. latency stable. pushing to 100% in 2m if no regression.

james-support: I'll update AcmeCorp: brief note that we identified config regression introduced by an env var change, kill-switch engaged, micropatch rolling, no data loss, services restoring. ETA ~10m. They appreciate the quick response.

mohit: heads-up: my shift starts in 40m; I'm taking over after this handoff. if anything spikes after patch, call me. @elaine please add any follow-ups to my oncall card.

elaine: will do. adding checklist to the incident doc and opening follow-up issues: root-cause analysis, gating extra CI test for env-var validation, monitoring alert threshold adjustment.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, impact=partial (eu), actions=flag-kill, micropatch-deploy, revert-commit, customer-notified, next=postmortem

sam: postmortem owner? volunteering: sam/setup RCA doc and timeline.

mohit: I'll own remediation tickets and follow-through with the deployment hygiene changes.

elaine: ok passing oncall to mohit in ~35m. temporary incident channel will remain open until postmortem doc is ready. good job team :thumbsup:

james-support: closing customer loop in 15m with a summary and link to incident doc.

elaine: final note: no rollback of versions, just a single-commit revert + env toggle. marking incident as resolved for now. will file severity/impact numbers in the doc. :white_check_mark:
